caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden butter churn placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The churn is cylindrical, tapering slightly as it widens toward the bottom, and is made from vertical slats of wood in varying shades of brown, giving the appearance of natural wood grain. Three metallic bands, colored a dull gray, encircle the churn horizontally at different heights to hold the wooden slats together. The upper rim of the churn has a thicker, lighter-colored wooden band. Emerging vertically from the center of the churn’s open top is a wooden dasher with a handle that has a heart-shaped top, also rendered in a lighter brown shade. There are no additional objects or background details in the image.
title: Wooden Noggin
